records.text: Snarl is an apprentice blacksmith who hopes to earn Saru's approval and compete for one of Saru's daughters. He warns others away from Sumi and Tumi, saying they are spoken for.
Hanashi is a weapon master who teaches visitors how to wield new weapons.
Snang is an apprentice tailor who uses animal pelts and skins in their creations.
Thund is an apprentice engineer who takes pride in Orcish ingenuity.

Eitrigg is a Horde veteran who says he left when the Burning Legion's influence grew, then returned after Thrall described a Horde free of demonic influence and guided by shamans. Thrall charged him with overseeing recruits.
Kor'ghan knows how to make an antidote from venomtail poison sacs and considers venomtails deadly. He calls Rhinag one of his own.

Neeru Fireblade is a warlock who says he volunteered to aid the young Warchief, seeking to show that Horde warlocks can serve without undermining it. He investigates demonic corruption in orc society, including the Burning Blade, and urges caution in judging others' motives.
An Orgrimmar guard who helps visitors find common services: the bank, wind rider master, guild master, and inn.
Karus is a banker who says he and his brothers fought at Hyjal. He vows to defend the bank from anyone who tries to rob it.
Doras is a wind rider master.
Olvia sells meat in Orgrimmar.
Trak'gen is a general-goods merchant.
Urtharo is a weapon merchant who speaks of years of battle and slavery and relief at having a home again. He tells customers to make their requests quickly.
Tor'phan is a cloth and leather armor merchant.
Handor is a cloth and leather armor merchant. Customers can browse his goods.
Ollanus is a light armor merchant. Customers can browse his goods.
Koma is a banker; customers can open their bank with her.
Sana is a mail armor merchant who offers goods to visitors.
Soran is a banker who says he and his brothers fought at Hyjal and stresses his personal commitment to the bank's security.
Morgum is a leather armor merchant who offers goods to visitors.
Kaja sells guns and ammunition and repairs equipment. She boasts that Orgrimmar has no finer firearms.
Horthus sells reagents.
Grol'dar trains warlocks and warns that arcane power corrupts the weak. He urges continued training to avoid that fate and says a strong will is needed to wield such forces.
Mirket trains warlocks and warns that arcane power can corrupt the weak. He says wielding these forces demands a strong will.
Zevrost trains warlocks and warns that the pursuit of power can bring corruption and addiction. He regards the arcane as corrupting only those too weak to master it.
Gest trains rogues and says the Shattered Hand will restore the Horde’s former glory unhindered by a timid Warchief.
Ormok trains rogues and says the Shattered Hand will restore the Horde’s former glory unhindered by a timid Warchief.
Kor'jus sells mushrooms in Orgrimmar.
Muragus is a staff merchant who offers goods and repairs.
Kareth is a blade merchant who offers goods and repairs.
Lumak is a fishing trainer who invites people to learn fishing.
Shankys sells fishing supplies in Orgrimmar.
Rekkul sells poison supplies in Orgrimmar.
Hagrus sells reagents in Orgrimmar.
Shan'ti sells fruit in Orgrimmar.
Kardris Dreamseeker is a shaman trainer who welcomes visitors in the name of the spirits.
Godan teaches enchanting. He says that adventurers who doubt its usefulness change their tune when he challenges them to battle.
Kithas supplies enchanting goods for browsing.
Yelmak is an alchemy trainer who says he is busy and directs visitors to Whuut. He worries that the young pup has been stewing all day and may hurt something.
Kor'geld is an alchemy-supplies merchant who offers goods for browsing.
Ukra'nor is a staff merchant who offers goods for browsing.
Asoran is a general-goods merchant who offers goods for browsing.
Magenius sells reagents in Orgrimmar.
Ormak Grimshot is a hunter trainer who offers hunter training and talent unlearning.
Grezz Ragefist is a warrior trainer who asks whether visitors want training or are wasting a warrior’s time. He warns those he does not train to find their own trainer before they anger him.
Sorek trains warriors and speaks impatiently to visitors who waste a warrior's time.
Saru Steelfury trains blacksmiths and speaks of the mysteries of the forge and secrets of steel.
Sumi sells blacksmithing supplies.
Makaru is a mining trainer who can instruct miners.
Gorina sells mining supplies.
Kiro makes war harnesses and repairs equipment.
Koru sells maces and staves and repairs equipment.
Shoma sells weapons and repairs equipment.
Ogunaro Wolfrunner is a kennel master who presents wolf mounts as hardy, enduring animals. His welcome is confident and sales-minded.
Magar trains tailors and takes pride in having made many of the goods in the store, teasing visitors to answer carefully since their life may depend on it.
Borya sells tailoring supplies.
Karolek is a leatherworking trainer who bristles at the suggestion that he stands idle. He directs shoppers to Handor.
Tamar sells leatherworking supplies.
Felika sells trade supplies in Orgrimmar.
Borstan sells meat in Orgrimmar.
Gotri sells bags in Orgrimmar.
Urtrun Clanbringer is a guild master who speaks for clans seeking to join those fighting beneath Orgrimmar's Warchief.
Tamaro is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Sarlek is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Arnok teaches First Aid. When a student needs further instruction, he directs them to Doctor Gregory Victor at Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.
Zamja is a cooking trainer who helps visitors seeking training.
Xen'to supplies cooking goods and lets customers browse his wares.

Shenthul is a rogue trainer and operative of the Shattered Hand, whose influence he describes as reaching across Kalimdor. He trains aspiring rogues and sends experienced members into the field when their service warrants it.

Zando'zan identifies himself with the Shattered Hand and keeps a guarded, self-effacing manner, speaking of himself in the third person. He frames training as preparation for becoming an operative and sends trainees to Wrenix in Ratchet for a task.
Sian'tsu is a troll shaman trainer who greets visitors warmly and invokes the spirits.
Jandi offers herbalism instruction.
Zeal'aya sells herbalism supplies.
Xor'juul is a hunter trainer.
Sian'dur trains hunters and invites them to learn the hunter’s ways of pride, honor and tradition.
Zel'mak is a warrior trainer who offers instruction in the warrior arts.
Zendo'jian is a weapon vendor who also repairs equipment.
Jin’sora is a bow merchant who sells goods and ammunition and repairs equipment.
Nogg is an apprentice engineer whose work includes Gnomish machinery. He seeks the plans for a new rig, showing a practical interest in engineering.
Sovik is an engineering-supplies vendor who invites travelers bound for Gnomeregan to speak with him.
Brakgul Deathbringer is a Warsong Gulch battlemaster who offers Horde fighters a chance to enter the battleground.
Galthuk is a two-handed weapons merchant who offers goods and repair services.
Zor Lonetree is an elder far seer consulted about Alliance politics and the history of a jeweled pendant among Stormwind nobles.
Belgrom Rockmaul is an Orgrimmar resident who hands out several tasks to those who seek him out.
Kildar is a riding trainer who teaches Wolf Riding.

Thrall is Warchief of the Horde and regards its members as equals. He teaches that defending the Horde must be balanced with honor and compassion toward friend and foe. Concerned for future generations, he sees helping the dwarves as a chance to strengthen relationships in the Eastern Kingdoms. In his plan to rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from Emperor Thaurissan, he insists she must not be harmed.
Garyl is a tabard vendor in Orgrimmar. He sells tabards and replaces a lost Blood Knight Tabard, Tabard of the Hand or Tabard of the Protector.
A brown riding wolf from Dun Morogh.
Grunt Komak is a grunt in Orgrimmar.
Grunt Mojka is a grunt in Orgrimmar.
Goma is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Zazo is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Kozish is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Barkeep Morag tends the bar and offers goods to visitors.
Doyo'da is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Sarok is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Craven Drok presents the Horde’s account of its relations with the Alliance, describing Thrall as a prudent diplomat and directing the listener to Keldran.
Keldran is a Horde representative concerned that Alliance forces may mistake Horde actions for pacts with the Burning Legion.
Kamari is an apprentice leatherworker who says they killed and skinned the beast used for their rug, and wishes centaur would fall as easily.
Tumi is a heavy armor merchant who offers goods and repairs equipment.

Kurgul presents himself as studying near the Altar of Storms, possibly to harness its energy for a hidden purpose. In the exchange tied to his quest, he directs warlocks seeking a dreadsteed to Mor’zul Bloodbringer and warns that the ritual demands substantial resources.
Katis is a wand merchant who offers goods to visitors.
Shimra supplies trade goods to visitors.
Gan'rul Bloodeye mentors warlocks in the summoning and binding of a voidwalker.
Pephredo is a mage trainer who calls magical instruction the hidden arts. Pephredo can address visitors with condescending pity, claiming that the secrets of true magic are beyond them.
Enyo trains mages in the hidden arts and pities those whom Enyo considers unable to grasp the secrets of true magic.
Deino is a troll mage who trains mages in the hidden arts and pities those whom Deino considers unable to grasp the secrets of true magic.

Searn Firewarder guides aspiring shamans through the elemental rites. When a trainee has mastered earth, he sends them to Kranal Fiss to learn fire; after fire, he directs them to Islen Waterseer for water.

Cazul is a blind warlock who guides trainees in summoning magic. When Gan'rul sends a trainee to learn the succubus rite, Cazul directs them to Zankaja in Orgrimmar to seek an object representing devotion and love.
Zankaja is Dogran's mate. He was sent to duty at the Crossroads, and she asks for news of him through Gazrog.
Thuul is a portal trainer who teaches mages about conjuring a portal back to the place where he teaches.
Zayus is a High Priest who offers training in priestly ways.
X'yera is a priest trainer who offers training in priestly ways.
Ur'kyo is a priest trainer who offers training in priestly ways and warns visitors to respect his people's ways.
Therzok is a Shattered Hand contact who recruits capable, discreet operatives and assigns covert work. His task for a recruit involves Tazan's satchel.
Gamon is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Innkeeper Gryshka welcomes battle-worn travelers to rest by the fire and share stories of their battles.
Dran runs Droffers and Son Salvage. He is practical and blunt, focused on getting equipment working, and calls Malton a dummy.
Malton works in the Droffers family salvage business and is an enthusiast for fine ripple. He speaks casually, with playful familiarity.
Zilzibin Drumlore is a troll scholar who studies life forms distinctive to Azeroth. He has investigated the silithid threat and considers it dangerous to life across the world.
Thuwd is a skinning trainer.
Shayis Steelfury trains armorsmiths and refuses to train smiths who have no skill or nothing decent to show.
Kelgruk Bloodaxe trains weaponsmiths and objects to being interrupted while busy.
Shim'la is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Uthel'nay trains mages in the hidden arts and pities those whom Uthel'nay considers unable to grasp the secrets of true magic.
Orokk Omosh is a blacksmith guarding his family's inherited craft recipes. With no heirs, he seeks capable students to carry the Omosh smithing legacy forward.
Aturk the Anvil teaches smithing and mourns the old life of battle under Thrall’s peace. He regards former enemies with weary suspicion, but turns from lament to instructing the learner.
Ox belongs to the Mithril Order and urges aspiring smiths to move beyond beginner work. He points them toward McGavan in Booty Bay, who can teach them about mithril.
Zas'Tysh greets people who may have attended an exclusive convention and gives a special prize to anyone who tells the secret code they were given there.
Kizzak Sparks sells holiday fireworks.
Xan'tish sells snakes in Orgrimmar.

Jes’rimon greets visitors on behalf of the Shattered Hand and describes its covert work in Orgrimmar as necessary for orc and troll safety. Pleased with Jediga’s work, he sends her payment and asks her to return to Orgrimmar.
Auctioneer Thathung handles auctions.
Auctioneer Wabang offers auction services to visitors.
A former Venture Company worker with knowledge of the samophlange, Rilli is asked to help repair one.

Furmund sees the Feast of Winter Veil as a time of renewal tied to the land and Greatfather Winter, and resents its commercial turn. He directs those interested in its history to Sagorne Creststrider.
Auctioneer Grimful provides auction services.
Xon'cha is a stable master who helps visitors stable their pets or recover a lost companion.
Xao'tsu trains hunters to teach their pets and says Xao'tsu only helps hunters and their pets.
Ug'thok is an apprentice blacksmith who wants to do his work well despite Snarl calling him slow. He says the job takes time.
Vol'jin receives reports concerning Admiral Proudmoore's orders in Thrall's chamber in Orgrimmar. He welcomes visiting heroes as a sign that the fates smile upon them.

Warcaller Gorlach greets visitors with news from both continents and beyond. He directs adventurers toward opportunities such as the Ashenvale hunt and the Cenarion Circle's exploration of Kalimdor's western frontier.
Roxxik is an engineering trainer who says he sometimes surprises even himself.
Whuut is an apprentice alchemist who brews potions.
Jhag is an apprentice enchanter who greets visitors and asks what they are seeking.
Krathok Moltenfist oversees the craftsmen.
Okothos Ironrager is an armorsmith who takes deep satisfaction in making steel that protects Horde warriors. He offers aspiring smiths a path into the craft, treating mastery as a journey.
Borgosh Corebender is a weaponsmith whose life's ambition is to forge a legendary hammer worthy of a Warchief. He sees potential in aspiring smiths and offers to help them develop it.
Sayoc is a weapon master who offers weapon training. He greets visitors with a brusque question about whether they have come to learn a new weapon or waste his time.
Grinning Dog is a dog found in Orgrimmar.
A dire riding wolf.
A timber riding wolf.
Legionnaire Teena is an Outland armor quartermaster who offers goods and repairs.
Blood Guard Hini'wana is a humanoid Blood Guard in Orgrimmar.
Advisor Willington is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Chieftain Earthbind is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Brave Stonehide is an Accessories Quartermaster who offers goods for sale.
Stone Guard Zarg is a Legacy Weapon Quartermaster who offers goods for sale.
First Sergeant Hola'mahi serves as a quartermaster and offers goods to visitors.
Raider Bork serves as a war mount quartermaster and offers goods to visitors.
Grunt Korf is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Grunt Bek'rah is a humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Sagorne Creststrider is a shaman trainer who teaches the ways of the spirits. He describes the Feast of Winter Veil as a season of renewal and values gathering accounts of its legends.

Kaymard Copperpinch sells Smokywood Pastures seasonal treats in Orgrimmar and sends visitors to Greatfather Winter. He also seeks help finding a missing shipment of treats and the Smokywood Pastures agent sent to find it.
Penney Copperpinch sells Smokywood Pastures food and Winter Veil goods in Orgrimmar. Her greetings are festive, urging customers to stock up for the holiday.
Greatfather Winter is a seasonal gift-giver who welcomes children and invites them to share what they hope to receive. His speech is warm but wry and hurried, and he asks for a treat himself.

Frostwolf Ambassador Rokhstrom recruits hardy outsiders into the Frostwolf campaign in Alterac Valley. He judges a prospective volunteer ready for battle and directs them to Warmaster Laggrond at the valley entrance to begin service against the Stormpike Guard.

Kolark introduces himself as a traveling bounty hunter from Thunder Bluff. He says journeys across the South Seas led him to thorium-headed arrows, but he has run out of shells; dismissing bows as unfit for a Tauren, he proposes an even trade of shells for arrows and invokes his word as a Tauren.
The Kor'kron Elite's taunts are openly contemptuous: it may throw rotten fruit, spit, or call a visitor a monster or murderer.
Stronghand is a scout who tangles foes in a hooked net.
Scout Manslayer is a scout who tangles foes in a hooked net.
Tharr is a scout who tangles foes in a hooked net.
Runthak declares himself Horde and says he carries out the Warchief’s commands without question. He publicly rallies the Horde behind its Warchief and its champions.

Orphan Matron Battlewail is associated with the Orgrimmar orphanage, where children who lost parents to Azeroth's conflicts can stay until old enough to fend for themselves. She describes Children's Week as the Horde's annual effort to give back to them.
Alowicious Czervik sells sweet treats.
Tosamina is a strict household authority who claims the children as hers and expects them to grow into the Horde. She demands obedience and cleanliness.
A Horde orphan in Orgrimmar.
A swift timber wolf.
A swift brown wolf.
A swift gray wolf.
Rashona Straglash is the Horde cloth quartermaster. She presents cloth donations as help for people in need and support for the war effort, using cloth for garments and bandages.
Vehena serves as a Horde cloth quartermaster. Vehena invites travelers to donate cloth and bandages for the Darkspear and describes the donations as a way to earn their respect.
Kruban Darkblade is the Darkmoon Faire's barker, calling visitors to see its attractions and welcoming an audience of all ages.
Kartra Bloodsnarl serves as an Alterac Valley battlemaster and offers to add willing fighters to the battleground's lists.
Deze Snowbane serves as the Arathi Basin battlemaster, offering access to the battleground and goods for sale.
Grinkle is a fishing promoter who invites anglers to test their skills at a Stranglethorn tournament.
Blackhoof is a Cenarion emissary who calls for aid from those willing to help.
Spoops is a sick child who wants to take part in Hallow's End trick-or-treating. He asks others to collect the city candies for him.
A Horde warbringer urges Horde members to join the fight against the Alliance and offers to exchange battleground marks for honor.
Rachelle Gothena offers Hallow's End treats for sale.
Commander Stronghammer serves as an Alliance ambassador.

Miner Cromwell collects copper bars for the Horde. Short of both time and people to do the smelting, Cromwell insists on bars rather than raw ore. Grateful for willing help, Cromwell encourages contributors as capable miners while pressing them to do their share.

Grunt Maug is proud to be in charge of collecting tin bars for the Horde's preparations for war. He is impatient for the fighting to begin and jokes about taking his frustration out on a supplier who is slow to help.
Senior Sergeant T'kelah is in charge of collecting mithril bars for the Horde's preparations for war and asks willing hands to mine, smelt and bring them in.
Herbalist Proudfeather collects Peacebloom.
Batrider Pele'keiki collects Firebloom.
Apothecary Jezel collects Purple Lotus and knows it as a reagent for potions, elixirs and oils.
Skinner Jamani collects Heavy Leather, which is used for war materiel such as reinforcement, armor and tarps.
Sergeant Umala collects thick leather for the Horde's preparations for the Ahn'Qiraj war. Umala presents the work as service and honor, and asks adventurers to help supply it.
Doctor Serratus collects rugged leather in service to the Horde's Ahn'Qiraj war effort. His remarks about knives and sharp edges give his request a controlled, menacing tone.
Healer Longrunner coordinates the Horde's wool-bandage collection and speaks from first-hand experience of soldiers needing care in the field.
Lady Callow is entrusted with collecting Mageweave Bandages for the Horde. She asks contributors to bring them to her; fresh bandages are preferred but not required.
Stoneguard Clayhoof collects Runecloth Bandages to distribute to soldiers preparing to fight the silithid at Ahn'Qiraj, and asks adventurers to help gather supplies.
Bloodguard Rawtar gathers and salts Lean Wolf Steaks for preparations for the war against the silithid at Ahn'Qiraj, and asks adventurers to bring more supplies.
Fisherman Lin'do collects Spotted Yellowtail for the Horde's Ahn'Qiraj war effort and asks others to help gather the fish.
Chief Sharpclaw collects Baked Salmon for the Horde's Ahn'Qiraj war effort. He explains that gathered food sustains those preparing for the war.
Elder Darkhorn reflects on a past when his community hunted for glory and honor, and wonders how much life has changed.
A War Effort Recruit in Orgrimmar.
Warlord Gorchuk is the War Effort Commander.
Senior Sergeant Kai'jin is the War Effort Recruiter.
The Orgrimmar Commendation Officer accepts Commendation Signets, handed in one at a time or ten together.
The Darkspear Commendation Officer accepts Commendation Signets, handed in one at a time or ten together.
The Undercity Commendation Officer handles exchanges involving Commendation Signets.
The Thunder Bluff Commendation Officer handles exchanges involving Commendation Signets.
Great-father Winter's Helper announces that Father Winter has left gifts beneath the tree for everyone.
Officer Vu'Shalay handles Darkspear commendations and accepts Commendation Signets, one at a time or ten together.
Officer Redblade handles Orgrimmar commendations and accepts Commendation Signets, one at a time or ten together.

A Cenarion Circle herald carries the Lunar Festival’s invitation to Azeroth’s peoples. In the capital cities, the herald points visitors toward the local moonlit celebration and can explain the festival; the invitation is broad, but the arrangements are made city by city.
Mokvar offers to exchange an armor piece for Silithus venom samples, gold, and a set of bracers. He addresses visitors as people who have seen and done much in the world.
Gurky is a named non-combat pet in Orgrimmar.
Tharl Stonebleeder greets people who may have attended an exclusive convention and gives a special prize to anyone who tells the secret code they were given there.
A scout of the Argent Dawn.
An Argent Dawn messenger who warns of Scourge attacks across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms and urges both Horde and Alliance to take up arms to defend their lands.
Lieutenant Dagel serves the Argent Dawn.
Ambassador Dawnsinger is a courteous ambassador who greets visitors warmly. Her known work includes asking a traveler to carry a report to Advisor Sunsworn at Splintertree Post.
An orc commoner who talks about the Lunar Festival in Moonglade, honoring elders, fireworks, and seasonal legends.

A Troll commoner whose conversation centers on seasonal celebrations, fireworks, and the Lunar Festival. They speak casually about the festivities and Moonglade, reflecting a celebrant's perspective without establishing a formal duty or personal connection to its druids.
Councilor Arial D'Anastasis is a humanoid councilor in Orgrimmar.
Zeggon Botsnap serves as a battlemaster for the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit's arena battlegrounds.
Andrissa Heartspear is the Eye of the Storm battlemaster, who helps those who want to fight in that battleground.
Master Pyreanor trains paladins in manipulating the naaru’s power. Pyreanor stresses iron will and unfaltering resolve, dismissing aspirants judged to lack those qualities.
An honor guard of the Blood Knights.
Krixx retrieves parts for the zeppelin and says he has a tracking device for travelers asking about service to Undercity or Grom'gol. He complains that Frezza does not pay him an hourly wage.

A Master Flame Eater teaches visitors new ways to handle fire at the Fire Festival in Horde capitals. The flame eater welcomes celebrants, urges them to honor the local flame and warns them not to get burned.

Muja is a battleground enthusiast associated with souvenirs from contests held in honor of the Spirits of Competition. He describes Alliance and Horde competitors wearing tabards in battlegrounds to honor the spirits and earn their favor.
Ray'ma is a Brew of the Month Club member who offers Brewfest goods for tokens.
Bebri Coifcurl welcomes customers to the barbershop and offers appearance services such as hair and facial-hair grooming, coloring, piercings, tattoos, and reshaping horns or other features.
Apothecary Karlov assists Grand Apothecary Putress with plague research and attends Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar.
Ufuda Giant-Slayer serves as a Strand of the Ancients battlemaster.
War-Hunter Molog is an Arena Battlemaster.
Greela “The Grunt” Crankchain is an arena organizer.
Jo'mah is an Inscription trainer who teaches the craft.
Xantili sells inscription supplies.

Thrall is the Horde’s Warchief and wants to be remembered for decisions that best served his people. In responding to the Wrathgate crisis, he condemns betrayal from within and demands justice. He speaks directly with Jaina and coordinates with Vol’jin. He warns that a forced conflict would leave divided forces in Northrend vulnerable to the Lich King.
A humanoid called an Orgrimmar Grunt, found in Durotar and Orgrimmar.
Sylvanas Windrunner, the Banshee Queen, says the Undercity coup was led by Varimathras and Apothecary Putress, and distinguishes their betrayal from the Horde's actions.
Karus is a banker.
Koma is a banker.
Soran is a banker.
Kaja deals in guns and ammunition and questions why Thrall allows harm to the city.
A humanoid named Gamon in Orgrimmar.
Olvia is a meat vendor in Orgrimmar. She asks where the Warchief is and wonders why Forsaken are here.
Doras is a Wind Rider Master who offers fast travel. His available greeting calls for guards.
Felika deals in trade supplies. She asks what is going on and calls the situation an outrage.
Sana is a mail armor merchant who demands answers about events.
Auctioneer Thathung asks what is going on.
Overlord Runthak speaks with command authority, warning of conflict with the Alliance and invoking the Warchief's efforts to protect his people.
Innkeeper Gryshka is an innkeeper who wants the shops reopened and is angry that they remain closed.
An orc commoner found in Orgrimmar.
A Forsaken survivor who fled Undercity with others after demons and Putress' apothecaries attacked. They are homeless, ask for help, and hope the Dark Lady survived.
A displaced Forsaken refugee seeking aid. Frightened by the attack, they fear for the Dark Lady and do not know whether she survived.

Thrall is the Horde’s Warchief. In addressing Jaina about the Wrathgate, he condemns internal betrayal and seeks justice for Putress’s attacks. He aims to avoid conflict with the Alliance while insisting that the Horde will defend itself if provoked. He warns that divided forces in Northrend would leave both sides vulnerable to the Lich King.
A Kor'kron Elite humanoid in Orgrimmar.
Sergeant Thunderhorn serves as an apprentice armor quartermaster and offers armor goods to visitors.
Doris Volanthius serves as a veteran armor quartermaster and offers armor goods to visitors.
Blood Guard Zar'shi serves as an armor quartermaster, offering goods to visitors.
Sergeant Thunderhorn is an apprentice armor quartermaster who offers goods to visitors.
Sergeant Thunderhorn is an apprentice armor quartermaster who offers goods and repairs.
Lady Palanseer is a Jewelcrafting Quartermaster who offers goods for sale.
Doris Volanthius is a Veteran Armor Quartermaster who offers goods and repairs.
Doris Volanthius is a Veteran Armor Quartermaster who offers goods and repairs.
Blood Guard Zar'shi is a Northrend armor quartermaster who offers goods for sale.
Karg Skullgore is a battlemaster who asks whether you are ready to fight for the Horde.
Sawemba is a battlemaster who fights with fire and frost magic.
Gorom Warfang serves as an Isle of Conquest battlemaster.
Gotura Fourwinds serves the Earthen Ring and urges listeners to heed the ancient elemental spirits.
Slahtz offers, for a fee, to stop a person from ever gaining experience again, and to undo it later for the same fee.
Magister Savarin is a Wintergrasp battle-mage who sends people to join the battle for Wintergrasp.
A humanoid known as Rogg.

The Steamwheedle cartel hires Detective Snap Snagglebolt to investigate newcomers to its holiday business. Snap distrusts Crown Chemical Co. and uses an air analyzer around perfumed guards to learn what the perfume contains. Snap objects to being sprayed with it.

Kwee Q. Peddlefeet is a Crown Chemical Co. event mascot promoting the Charitable Charms program. Authorized to distribute Lovely Charm Collector's Kits, Kwee explains bracelets as gifts of affection or tokens for exchange. Kwee encourages making one for Thrall, the Warchief, as a gesture of appreciation.

Roka is an orc who recalls love at first sight with Snivel Rustrocket and his promise of a South Seas vacation. Her attachment gives way to worry that he has abandoned her. The possibility of being deceived or enchanted provokes hurt and fierce anger; she wants Snivel caught before he can escape.

place_records.text: You are in Orgrimmar, Horde land on Kalimdor, where nearly all of the friendly people are Horde and a few are neutral. Its services include an inn, a bank, a flight master and a stable master.
